gameName: The Lord of the Rings: Fate of the Fellowship

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The Lord of the Rings: Fate of the Fellowship rulebook (Z-Man Games)

steps.text: Game board in the center
Threat rate marker and hope marker on the dotted space of their tracks
The 2 special shadow cards (Sauron, Saruman) into the shadow discard pile; shuffle the rest (both backs) facedown as the shadow deck
Dwarven troops (grey): 1 each in Ered Luin, Erebor, Iron Hills
Elven troops (green): 1 each in Grey Havens, Rivendell, Lorien, Woodland Realm
Rohirrim troops (brown): 1 each in Helm's Deep, Edoras, Eastemnet
Gondor troops (blue): 2 in Minas Tirith, 2 in Dol Amroth, 1 in Pelargir; the rest of each type in the supply (5 each)
18 shadow troops: Dunland 1, Isengard 1, Moria 2, Dol Guldur 1, Rhun 3, Minas Morgul 2, Barad-dur 2, Nurn 3, Umbar 1, Near Harad 2
Draw 9 shadow cards one by one: 1 shadow troop on each card's red location (ignore other text); discard them; 21 troops stay in the supply
9 Nazgul: Eriador 2, Rhudaur 1, Misty Mountains 1, Gondor 1, Mordor 4
Eye of Sauron on Eriador
Destroy the One Ring (red star) + 3 random objectives faceup by the board; box the rest; follow their setup text
First game: Attain the Blessing of the Elves; Saruman, Your Staff Is Broken; Challenge Sauron; Destroy the One Ring
Characters required by objectives + random ones up to 2 per player; shuffle and deal 2 each; 2 reference cards each
First game: P1 Frodo & Sam + Legolas, P2 Merry & Pippin + Eowyn, P3 Arwen + Aragorn, P4 Gandalf + Boromir, P5 Gimli + Eomer
Solo: Frodo & Sam card by the board; 4 random characters faceup in a row; solo token on the leftmost
steps.note: First game: Merry & Pippin, Eowyn, Legolas, Gandalf

steps.text: Figures on their characters' starting locations; box unused characters, figures and reference cards
steps.note: Aragorn Weather Hills, Arwen Rivendell, Boromir/Faramir Minas Tirith, Eomer Eastemnet, Eowyn Edoras, Frodo & Sam and Merry & Pippin The Shire, Galadriel Lorien, Gandalf Tharbad, Gimli Erebor, Gollum Moria, Legolas Woodland Realm

steps.text: Set aside the 12 Skies Darken cards; shuffle the 14 events and take {n} unseen
Shuffle them with the 48 region cards; deal {n} cards each, faceup
Split the rest into {n} facedown stacks; shuffle 1 Skies Darken into each; pile them (larger stacks on top) on the draw space
Box the unused events and Skies Darken cards unseen
Hand limit 7 cards
No limit on shadow troops in a location
Solo: the solo-token character takes 4 actions plus 1 Frodo & Sam bonus action; no Fellowship action
The player whose region card shows the lowest number goes first
steps.note: First game: the Frodo player starts

steps.text: The leftmost character takes the first turn
